g.text: Each subclass implements the specific behaviour:
• BasicAttack: damage = ATK − DEF, calls takeDamage()
• Defend: wraps actor in a DefendBuff StatusEffect
• UseItem: delegates to item.use(), then removes item
• UseSpecialSkill: casts actor to Player, calls
activeEffects and call the relevant hooks:
for 2 of the bearer's own turns, then expires.
causing BattleEngine to skip the enemy's AI action.
whenever the attacker is an Enemy instance,
making the player invulnerable for 2 turns.
• Potion: calls player.heal(100) — restores up to 100 HP.
— fires the player's special skill immediately with
no cooldown penalty, effectively bypassing the 3-turn wait.
• SmokeBomb: applies SmokeBombEffect to the player,
granting 2 turns of full damage immunity vs enemies.
